translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content.text: “Ee, angʼeyo ni gima iwachono en adier.
To ere kaka dhano mangima nyalo bedo kare e nyim Nyasaye?
Kata dabed ni ngʼato dwaro mino kode wach,
to bende dhano diduok penjo achiel kuom penjoge alufu achiel.
Riekone tut kendo tekre ngʼeny.
En ngʼa mosepiem kode miloye?
Ogolo gode kuonde ma gintie ka ok gingʼeyo
kendo ongʼielogi ka en gi mirima.
Oyiengo piny gie mise mare
kendo omiyo sirni mage yiengni.
Kowuoyo to chiengʼ ok rieny
kendo oumo ler mar sulwe.
En owuon ema noyaro polo
kendo en ema nonyono apaka madongo mag nam.
En ema nochweyo sulwe madongo kaka, yugni, oluoro-budho, ratego,
kod sulwe mogudore mathoth man yo milambo.
Otimo gik madongo miwuoro mayombo pach dhano,
honni mathoth ma ok kwanre.
Ka okadho buta to ok anyal nene;
ka odhi nyima to ok anyal yange.
Kokawo gimoro odhigo; to en ngʼa manyalo tame?
En ngʼa manyalo penje ni, ‘Ma to angʼo ma itimoni?’
Nyasaye ok gengʼ mirimbe kendo nyaka jolwenj Rahab
bende noloyo mopodho e tiende.
“Ere kuma dayudie weche ma dawachne?
Koro ere kaka damin kode wach?
Kata dabed ni aonge richo kata achiel, to ok dadwoke;
anyalo mana ywagora ne jangʼadna bura mondo okecha.
Kata dabed ni aluonge mi obiro ira,
to ok ayie ni onyalo winjo wachna.
Mirimb Nyasaye nyalo tieka
kendo onyalo miyo adhondena medore kayiem nono.
Ok onyal weya aywe
to otimona mana gik mamiyo chunya bedo malit.
Kaponi teko ema iwuoyoe, to otek ndi,
kendo kata ka adiera ema ilose,
to en ngʼa manyalo chune
mondo obi onyis wach kuome.
Kata dabed ni aonge richo kata achiel,
to dhoga pod biro mana ndhoga.
Kata dabed ni aonge rach moro amora,
to dhoga pod biro miyo inena kaka jaketho.
“Kata dabed ni aonge gi ketho moro amora,
to onge ber maneno,
nikech ngimana en kayiem nono.
Ma emomiyo aneno ni gik moko duto chalre
nikech okumo joma onge ketho kod joma timbegi richo machalre.
Ka masira oneko apoya,
to pek ma ngʼat makare oyudo ok obadhe.
Nyasaye oseketo piny e lwet joma timbegi richo,
bende omiyo jongʼad bura duto bedo muofni.
To ka ok en ema notimo kamano,
to ngʼatno mane otimo mano?
“Ndalona ringo mapiyo moloyo jangʼwech;
girumo piyo ka gionge mor kata matin.
Gikadho piyo mana ka yiedhi molos gi oundho maringo e nam,
kendo ka ongoe mafuyo e kor polo karango piny mondo omak nyagweno.
Ka anyalo wacho ni wiya owil gi gik maricho ma Nyasaye osetimona,
to abiro loko pacha mi abed mamor.
Kata kamano, pod aluoro aluora masira momaka
nikech angʼeyo ni Nyasaye ok nyal kwana ka ngʼat maonge ketho.
Kaka koro osekawa ni an jaketho,
angʼo ma dimi pod anyagra nono?
Kata dine aluokra gi sabun
mi aluok lwetena maler,
to pod ibiro luta mana e chwodho mi nyaka lepa
bende biro jok koda.
“Nyasaye ok en dhano kaka an ma dahedhra dwokora kode,
kata madimi wayal kode e od bura.
Ka dine bed ni nitie ngʼato manyalo bedo jathek e kinda gi Nyasaye,
kata ngʼato manyalo ngʼado bura e kinda kode,
kata ngʼat manyalo golo kum mare kuoma,
mondo omi masichene kik bwoga,
eka dine awuoyo ka ok aluore,
to kaka weche chal sani, ok anyal timo kamano.”
